why: The gameplay HUD's identity must come from the canonical descriptor, not from a boot-time guess. RE-ANCHORED for issue #324's step S6, which folded `setSessionKind` into the one status projection at this same site. Pinning switchTo's push to 'campaign' is the shape issue #316's review found shipped: a developer-flag versus session (?dev=1&mode=ffa) built a genuine FFA world while telling the HUD it was Campaign, which hid the versus stock strip and left the campaign Lives/Enemies stats on screen. It also reintroduces the Practice/Campaign divergence on the menu Level-Select path. Scoped to loop.test.ts, whose 'Gameplay HUD identity comes from the descriptor' block asserts the kind at the production composition boundary; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
